title: Retail Installment Contracts: Returned-Item Fee Schedule by Returned Amount
content:
For a contract under Retail Installment Contracts whose contract state is **AL, FL, MS or LA**, the fee amount of a returned payment follows the returned-item fee schedule, read from the amount of the returned payment:

| Amount of the returned payment | Fee amount |
|---|---|
| more than 300.00 | 30.00 |
| more than 50.00, up to and including 300.00 | 27.50 |
| 50.00 or less | the tier's returned-payment fee |

For a contract in any other state, the fee amount for every returned payment is the tier's returned-payment fee.

The amount of a returned payment equals the amount of the original payment the bank returned.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical returns, Mississippi contract).** 300.00 returned: 27.50. 300.01 returned: 30.00. 50.00 returned: the tier's returned-payment fee. 50.01 returned: 27.50. A 640.00 return on an Ohio contract: the tier's returned-payment fee.
